10/ I say: "I don't have to ask them why. I know why. It's because of my political beliefs."

She looks directly in my eyes.

I say: "Do you know about #BlackLivesMatter?"

She thinks.

I say: "Saint Louis, Missouri." I say: "Michael Brown."

She says: "Now I know what you mean."

As a Bostonian who lived in Saint Louis from 2013-2017---a period overlapping the murder of Michael Brown, Jr.---and who was very active in #BlackLivesMatter & #FergusonFrontline movements, I feel the need to respond, at some point, to this ignorant & misguided letter from  BPPA:

More broadly, I really wish in general that people who were not present in Saint Louis and Ferguson, MO during the period of time in question would stop offering commentary----any commentary, in fact----on #BlackLivesMatter, on #Ferguson, or on the murder of Michael Brown.

Thread. You can put money on Josh's books through JPay. He would also appreciate paper letters. Most current address and contact info. for him in the thread.
